label: PF Backlog 608
title: Harden sync_develop on a dirty/noisy working tree (untracked collisions; merge refused; generated-file hygiene)
body:
## Problem / why
During BI-PF-1318 delivery, `git merge --autostash origin/develop` (the sync) was REFUSED because untracked
working-tree files collided with files the merge wanted to add ("The following untracked working tree files
would be overwritten by merge"); the manual `git merge` hit the same wall, and `git merge --abort` then failed
("Could not reset index file to revision 'HEAD'") - leaving a stuck half-merge. Root: generated/stray files
(dashboard/docs/*.pdf, products/inbox/*, docs/*.md, ad-hoc temp scripts) accumulate untracked/modified, so a
frequent sync is fragile exactly when it matters.

## Goal & value
A sync that just works on a realistic (noisy) working tree, so "sync often" stays reliable.

## In scope
- sync_develop.py: when a merge is refused due to untracked collisions, report the EXACT files and offer/perform
  a safe recovery (stash-untracked or move-aside), instead of a bare failure.
- Generated-file hygiene: ensure the high-churn generated paths (dashboard/docs/**, products/inbox/**,
  products/_test_*/**) are gitignored or excluded so they never block a merge.
- `git merge --abort` robustness: if abort fails, give a clear recovery path.

## Out of scope
- Changing what is generated.

## Acceptance criteria
- A sync on a tree with the known generated noise completes without "untracked would be overwritten".
- A refused merge names the blocking files + prints the recovery.
- Tests cover the noisy-tree case; precheck passes.

## Rollback
Revert the sync change; keep the .gitignore additions (harmless).

## Related
BI-PF-1290 / BI-PF-1318 (the sync + hooks). Epic BI-PF-1248.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/sync_develop.py (from BI-PF-1290/1318): catch refused merges, diff untracked collisions via `git merge --dry-run`/`git status`, print exact blocking files, and auto stash-untracked (`git stash -u`) or move-aside before retrying; on abort failure fall back to `git reset --merge` then `git merge --abort --quit`. Add high-churn generated paths to .gitignore (dashboard/docs/**.pdf, products/inbox/**, products/_test_*/**) so they never block a merge. Do NOT touch merge_gate.py APIs.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-1318 (done/delivered) so sync_develop.py exists in its current form.
RELATED BI-PF-1249 (generated-doc hygiene) for consistent gitignore/path choices.
conflict_findings: core/merge_gate.py (/api/v1/gates/pr/merge) touches merge semantics — ensure no overlapping edits; this item targets the worker sync script, not the server gate.
If BI-PF-1318 hooks are still being amended, coordinate to avoid concurrent sync_develop.py edits.
duplication_findings: BI-PF-1290 already auto-resolves generated docs/counters on merge; this item must extend that helper, not fork a new one.
BI-PF-1318 added pre-commit auto-sync; retry/recovery logic must land in the shared sync_develop.py used by both hooks.
No existing backlog item handles untracked-collision recovery (BI-PF-1252 unscoped, score low).
analysis.rationale: Clear incident-driven hardening of an existing script with well-known noise paths; low drift, reuse of sync_develop.py, tests feasible in a scratch repo.
assumptions: The generated noise paths listed in the item are still accurate current hot spots.
Workers run sync on real working trees, not worktrees (worktree APIs exist but are out of scope).
risks: Auto `git stash -u` can stash real user work; recovery must be loud and reversible (stash list printed).
gitignore additions could mask files a developer expects to commit (e.g. dashboard docs).
`git reset --merge` fallback may discard in-progress merge state unexpectedly.
evidence: Incident captured in BI-PF-1318 delivery notes: untracked collision refusal + failed merge --abort.
Affected files named: dashboard/docs/*.pdf, products/inbox/*, docs/*.md, temp scripts.
missing_info: Should auto-stash be default or prompt-gated (interactive vs CI/hook non-interactive)?
Confirm the final gitignore allowlist so intentional generated docs can still be committed if desired.

context_review.reason: Names sync_develop.py, explains the failure (untracked collisions, failed abort), and gives concrete behaviors (detect collisions, name blocking files, print recovery, abort robustness, gitignore hygiene) plus verifiable acceptance criteria; IN_SCOPE bullets are truncated but intent is inferable.

api_impact.reason: retrofit assessment (ADR-0007): no external API consumer recorded; treated as internal until an API surface is required (then set needs_api=true with routes)
